title: "Propensity Methods"

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Goal

Improve measured covariate balance between exposure groups.

Possible approaches:

- matching
- inverse probability weighting
- overlap weighting

## Required diagnostics

- standardized mean differences
- pre/post balance
- retained sample size
- overlap/common support
